Alphabet (NASDAQ:GOOGL) Downgraded to Hold Rating by Wall Street Zen

Wall Street Zen downgraded shares of Alphabet (NASDAQ:GOOGL – Free Report) from a buy rating to a hold rating in a research note published on Saturday morning. GOOGL has been the topic of a number of other reports. Phillip Securities raised Alphabet from a “moderate buy” rating to a “strong-buy” rat
